To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NLO PQCD corrections to the B -> PV amplitudes are sizable, and that the B -> rho^\mp pi^\pm, K^\pm K^*, and rho^0 K_S modes are dominated by the annihilation penguin contributions.

(i) NLO corrections are essential for the B -> rho^0 pi^0 and omega^0 pi^+ modes, (ii) NLO corrections dramatically change the branching ratios and direct CP asymmettries of the B -> rho^\mp pi^\pm and omega^\mp K^\mp modes, (iii) the mixing-induced CP violations in the B -> rho pi and omega K decays can be as large as 0.8 and 0.5, respectively, and
the NLO PQCD corrections enhance the B -> PV branching ratios and the B -> rho^0 pi^0, rho^0 pi^- and rho^- pi^0 branching ratios are all suppressed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the penguin-dominated decays B -> PV, which are not only important for understanding the mechanism of the B decays, but also for testing the factorization hypothesis in the B decays.
the penguin-dominated decays of B mesons, which are very useful for studying the strong phases and the CKM angle gamma.
the NLO PQCD calculations of the penguin-dominated decays B -> PV.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PQCD is a good theory for B -> PV decaying modes.
PQCD is a promising framework for the study of B -> PV decaying modes.
the NLO PQCD approach can successfully describe the penguin-dominated decays of B -> PV modes, which have been studied in the literature with the factorization approximation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the B -> rho^0K_S and B -> omega K_S branching ratios are large and the direct CP asymmetry A_{CP}( B^0 -> rho^0_K_S) can be as large as 0.2.
the NLO penguin-dominated B decays are dominated by the scalar penguin amplitudes, which are the annihilation and color-suppressed ones, while the color-allowed tree amplitudes are suppressed.
the B -> K_phi, pi K^* and B -> rho K and omega K modes are all promising to be observed in the near future, and the B -> pi K^* mode is a golden channel for the measurement of the CKM angle gamma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the penguin-dominated decays B -> rho K^*, phi K^* can be used to test the PQCD formalism.
the B -> rho^0, omega K decays should be studied in the near future.

, with a reasonable value of the B_{B_s}(0^-) decay constant, the B_{B_d}(0^-) and the B_{B_{s}}(0^-) decay constants can be extracted from the B -> phi K_S, pi K^* and phi K_S, rho^0 K_S branching ratios and the direct CP asymmetry A_{CP}(phi K_S), respectively.
